documents.title: Guidelines for Using Artificial Intelligence Tools and Platforms in Connection with Academic Work
documents.summary: Provost guidelines (Aug 2026) update 2023 guidance. They set a university default (AI-generated submissions are cheating unless the instructor permits; AI allowed for unsubmitted study work; no AI in assessments) and offer three model syllabus options for instructors.
documents.stance_why: The page says instructors 'might 1) permit ... 2) permit their use for certain purposes ... or 3) forbid' and supplies General Permission, Selective Permission and General Prohibition templates, so tiers are offered and the decision is delegated. A default prohibition applies only 'in the absence of explicit directions to the contrary from instructors'.

documents.title: Additional Guidance Regarding Generative AI in Connection with Academic Work (For Faculty)
documents.summary: August 2023 letter from the Provost with practical advice for faculty: communicate expectations, allow disclosure where AI is permitted, redesign assignments, and be cautious with detection since no tool reliably detects AI text.
documents.stance_why: The letter sets no rule on student AI use itself; it advises instructors, e.g. 'Allow students to disclose, if the instructor permits the use of GAI', leaving the choice to them.

units.why: Asks instructors to 'reinforce what plagiarism/cheating is' and state expectations for original work, communicating expectations, P09.
units.anchor: your expectations for turning in original work

units.why: 'Consider including a declaration of honesty in your assignments' asks students to promise integrity, P29.
units.anchor: Consider including a declaration of honesty in your assignments
units.frag_start: Consider including a declaration of honesty

units.why: 'Allow students to disclose ... the use of GAI tools' and explain how it helped, disclosure with submission, P24.
units.anchor: Allow students to disclose, if the instructor permits the use of GAI

units.why: 'Require at all levels meticulous citing of peer-reviewed and published work' redesigns assignment requirements, P35.
units.anchor: Require at all levels meticulous citing of peer-reviewed and published work

units.why: 'Consider allowing draft submissions prior to final submissions' to reduce use of unauthorized tools, assignment redesign, P35.
units.anchor: Consider allowing draft submissions prior to final submissions

units.why: 'Plagiarism detection tools are available and should be used if you suspect a breach', similarity checking, P40.
units.anchor: Plagiarism detection tools are available and should be used if you suspect a breach in

units.why: 'No tools that can reliably detect GAI-generated text' and false positives are risky, so detectors are not reliable, P39.
units.anchor: no tools that can reliably detect GAI-generated text

units.anchor: Be clear in your expectations and refer to learning objectives and grading rubrics

units.why: 'Ask students to present work they have done orally or in a public forum' checks understanding, P34.

units.why: Chatbots 'use verbiage repetitively'; 'look for phrases that were never used in the classroom' is detection by reading work, P40 (process/evidence), not P39.
units.anchor: Look for phrases that were never used in the classroom

units.why: 'Encourage creative and critical writing prompts ... more analysis and synthesis' redesigns assignments around chatbot limits, P35.
units.anchor: Encourage creative and critical writing prompts in your assignments

units.why: 'Chatbots do not cite their own writing and can generate false citations' says AI output is unreliable, P31.
units.anchor: do not cite their own writing and can generate false citations

units.why: 'Spot-check cited materials to ensure that they exist' uses process evidence to find misuse, P40.
units.anchor: Spot-check cited materials to ensure that they exist

units.anchor: Require citations by students to ensure that peer-reviewed and published material

units.why: 'Seek out inconsistencies and materials that do not adhere to course materials' is detection by content check, P40.
units.anchor: Seek out inconsistencies and materials that do not adhere to course materials

units.why: 'Require students to write within context using real or even fictitious scenarios' redesigns assignments, P35.
units.anchor: Require students to write within context using real or even fictitious scenarios
units.frag_start: Require students to write within context

units.why: 'There is no failsafe method to prevent plagiarism' while tools can limit AI use, a statement about limits of enforcement, closest P40.
units.anchor: there is no failsafe method to prevent plagiarism

units.why: 'Assistance from the LAI Instructional Core professional staff is always available' is faculty support, P63.
